messages:
Anya: Heads-up quick design review for playground streaming controls. Users think 'Stop' equals 'pause' and get surprised. Figma: https://fig.ma/file/streaming-ux-v6. Want input on labels, affordances, and token peek opt-in.
Tom: I keep coming back to verbs. Suggest "Pause" (keeps resume) vs "Discard" (clear). 'Stop' is ambiguous.
Rina: +1. Also propose a tiny persisted status pill under the message when paused: [Paused 3 tokens buffered] with a small Resume action. Show TTL: "expires in 2:45".
Owen: runtime note  we hold KV for 180s. If the model changes during that window, resume should be blocked and we show: "Resume unavailable 1 model changed".
Anya: copy options I'm testing: "Pause  Resume" and "Discard (clears response)". Any microcopy tweaks?
Tom: Hover microcopy: "Pause to temporarily stop generation and resume later." For Discard confirmation: "Discard current response  this cannot be undone." Keep it short.
Rina: token peek: dev-only toggle in Settings. Desktop: hover to show "3 tokens  est $0.0003". Mobile: long-press. Don't surface tokens by default.
design-bot: icon nits: Pause = two vertical bars, Resume = play icon, Discard = filled square (danger color). Use outline vs filled to show destructive.
aria-bot: accessibility checklist: pill must be focusable, announce state changes with aria-live polite region ("Response paused; press Resume to continue"), document keyboard shortcuts in Help.
Anya: keyboard shortcuts proposal: Space = Pause/Resume when message pane focused, D = Discard (with confirm), R = Regenerate. Confirm copy must be explicit.
Owen: edge case: if user hits Regenerate while paused, we should default to starting fresh and warn: "Regenerate will discard paused response."
Tom: research note: non-dev users prefer minimal UI; show pill only when paused or hovered. Dev mode opt-in for token peek.
Anya: action items: I'll update Figma with Pause pill + TTL and the microcopy. Owen to add resume-block banner prototype. Rina to draft a small doc for Developer Mode token peek. aria-bot to produce a11y acceptance criteria.
Anya: I'll push mocks by EOD PST and tag this thread. Thanks! :rocket:
